text:
Avery (Product): Quick sync — before GA we need to lock pricing deltas and the support trigger thresholds. Question: do we keep burst pricing opt-in?
Marco (Eng): prefer simple tiering. If realtime throughput > 500 req/min we route to reserved capacity and surface a notice. Keep burst as opt-in + throttle.
Priya (SRE): SLOs proposal: 99.95% availability, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 300ms. Alerts: page if p99 > 350ms for 5m OR if error rate > 5% for 3m. Also require a circuit-breaker and automatic fallback policy.
Connor (FinOps): pricing delta idea: +15% uplift for the low-latency tier OR a flat per-minute burst surcharge. I'll model customer impact today and post a sheet.
Avery (Product): action items: Connor -> pricing model numbers, Priya -> alert thresholds + runbook, Lina -> support playbook draft, Marco -> fallback mapping. Owners please ack.
Lina (Docs): I'll start a support playbook draft. Need: exact escalation path, canned customer messages, rollback steps. Nate (Support) can you confirm first-tier responsibilities?
Nate (Support): 1st-tier triages tickets and executes the immediate fallback (switch to compatible model variant). Escalate to SRE if rollback required or if >1 customer reports latency regressions. We also want a single-sentence status blurb for customers.
Marco (Eng): also need to confirm automatic fallback mapping: which model variants are acceptable for each workload class. I'll add an env var map and a small smoke-test.
Marco (Eng): smoke-test example (to validate end-to-end and fallback behavior):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-lowlatency-1","prompt":"smoke test"}'
```
Priya (SRE): we'll add a synthetic job every 5m hitting the canary and primary. If median latency deviates >30% from baseline for 10m -> create pager. If token error rate >10% for 5m -> page immediately.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: optimize-edge-v1 -> canary=10% at 2025-06-12T09:20:00Z
Avery (Product): timeline: final sign-off needed by EOD Friday. Owners: Connor (pricing), Priya (alerts/runbook), Lina (support doc), Marco (fallbacks/smoke). Ping here when done.
Connor (FinOps): will post the impact sheet by tomorrow noon (will include sample invoices).
Lina (Docs): doc PR created, will ping once reviewers added.
Nate (Support): drafting the customer-facing paragraph for release notes and incident templates.
Avery (Product): thanks — if no major blockers I’ll mark this GA-ready and we’ll publish the rollout guide + change log.
